# An effect keyed on a loop's element bound by copy is refused where it is
# written, on every target: the element is a value nothing writes, so a report
# of writes to it would never run. `for var &x` binds the element itself, and
# each copy then reports the writes that reached its own
# (effect_changes_runs.txt).

! sngl check loop.sngl
stderr 'loop.sngl:8:29: an effect''s @update reports a write to what `on` reads, and `on` reads the loop variable "x", a copy nothing writes; bind the element with `for var &x` to report writes to it'

sngl check ref.sngl

-- loop.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

component rows ui.node {
    var xs list<list<int>> = [[1], [2]]
    var n = 0
    ui.vbox {
        for var x = xs {
            effect(on = x, @update { n += 1 })
        }
    }
}

ui.window(title = "Rows") {
    rows
}
-- ref.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

component rows ui.node {
    var xs list<list<int>> = [[1], [2]]
    var n = 0
    ui.vbox {
        for var &x = xs {
            effect(on = x, @update { n += 1 })
        }
    }
}

ui.window(title = "Rows") {
    rows
}
